recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not use FHIR-5437 to force Subscription.endpoint to 1..1; any future cardinality or Endpoint-resource relationship change should be handled through a newer explicit Subscription issue.
issue_request: FHIR-5437 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Subscription ballot comment requesting that the channel URL element be renamed to endpoint because targets such as email addresses are not ordinary URLs; the comment also suggested 1..1 cardinality, but the recorded resolution says to rename Subscription.url to Subscription.endpoint.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git-svn commit 5b1b287a952af278548982b89b750a645cd7808c (#5437 / SVN 4495), which renamed Subscription.channel.url to Subscription.channel.endpoint in the then-authoritative spreadsheet source and left the element cardinality at 0..1.
additional_context: Current R6 Subscription source is active in source/fhir.ini and defines Subscription.endpoint as a 0..1 url. Current channel guidance says websocket does not require the client to have an endpoint, while rest-hook, email, and message define channel-specific endpoint use. Later Applied issue FHIR-47344 clarified Subscription.endpoint as a channel-specific URL, including websocket URLs supplied by the server. Related FHIR-10190 was already audited on the combined branch and does not require another commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The endpoint rename is already present, and changing cardinality to 1..1 now would conflict with the current channel-dependent Subscription model and later applied endpoint clarification.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 clarification retained Subscription.endpoint as a channel-specific URL and clarified websocket/server-supplied endpoint behavior.
Published issue about Subscription endpoint vs Endpoint resource is already represented on the combined branch and reinforces not changing this field based on the older rename issue.
Triaged/unresolved typo issue surfaced in endpoint searches but is not final and does not affect the FHIR-5437 decision.
